reviews.title: Powerful and Stylish
reviews.comment:
The MSI Gaming RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16G GAMING X TRIO WHITE graphics card is a game-changer. I paired it with my MAG PANO 100L case, Z790 Project Zero motherboard, and an Intel i7-14700KF, and the performance boost is incredible. It handles everything smoothly, from gaming to content creation.
The white design fits perfectly with my setup, and the triple-fan cooling keeps it running cool and quiet. The zero RPM feature is a great addition, ensuring the fans only spin up when needed, making it super quiet during low loads. The RGB lighting adds a nice touch without being over the top. Installation was easy, and the card feels solid and well-built.
Overall, this graphics card is a perfect blend of power and style. Highly recommended for anyone looking to upgrade their gaming rig!
reviews.author: BibusCA

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY. It’s a scam
reviews.comment: They have this item listed as a 4070ti SUPER 16G. Check your Graphics memory. The listing shows 4070ti SUPER 16G memory. Don’t buy this. They even replaced the S/N number sticker. You can see where the sticker is coming up.
